';
const SITES=Object.freeze({rim:{name:'Sunlit crater rim',quality:'Strong exposure (training)',light:.94,icon:'☀',reason:'LROC illumination maps show why sun-facing high ground matters for mission planning.'},ridge:{name:'Partly lit ridge',quality:'Variable exposure (training)',light:.68,icon:'◐',reason:'Shifting shadows mean your fictional station needs more stored energy.'},shadow:{name:'Shadowed crater floor',quality:'Limited exposure (training)',light:.24,icon:'☾',reason:'Some polar crater interiors remain in deep shade. Plan power reserves carefully.'}});
const REMS=Object.freeze({cold:{label:'Coldest recorded air extreme',sol:329,kelvin:190.69,celcius:-82.46,pressure:null},mild:{label:'Warmest recorded air extreme',sol:164,kelvin:269.53,celcius:-3.62,pressure:null}});
// Solar classification entries, NOT a radiation-dose prediction or linear energy scale.
const SOLAR=Object.freeze([{utc:'02:09',value:1.7,label:'X1.7'},{utc:'12:55',value:1.2,label:'X1.2'},{utc:'16:51',value:8.7,label:'X8.7'}]);
const $=(sel,root=document)=>root.querySelector(sel);
const fmt=(n,d=0)=>Number(n).toFixed(d);
const clamp=(n,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,n));
const safe=(s)=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const link=(url,label='Open source ↗')=>`<a href="${url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${label}</a>`;
const metric=(label,value,tone='')=>`<div class="nx-metric" data-tone="${tone}"><small>${label}</small><b>${value}</b></div>`;
const evidence=(source,explanation,secondary)=>`<details class="nx-proof"><summary>View NASA evidence, methods & attribution</summary><p><b>Observed:</b> ${safe(source.name)}. ${safe(source.date)}.</p><p><b>Method:</b> ${safe(explanation)}</p><p><b>Training assumptions:</b> LUNA-7 is imaginary. Numeric station loads, site factors, radiation scenarios and time compression are invented teaching parameters, not measured by NASA.</p>${link(source.url)}${secondary?` · ${link(secondary,'Read research ↗')}`:''}</details>`;
const choice=(id,icon,title,description,selected)=>`<button type="button" class="nx-choice" data-choice="${id}" data-picked="${selected?'true':'false'}" aria-pressed="${selected?'true':'false'}"><span class="nx-choice-icon">${icon}</span><span><b>${title}</b><small>${description}</small></span><span class="nx-choice-check">${selected?'✓':'○'}</span></button>`;
function project(sim,site,loads,hrs=1){
 const cap=sim?.solarCapacityMax||52.2,shade=sim?.solarEventMultiplier??1;
 const solar=cap*site*shade,dem=Object.values(loads).reduce((a,b)=>a+Number(b||0),0),net=solar-dem;
 const initial=sim?.batteryCharge??210,max=sim?.batteryCapacityMax??250;
 return{solar,dem,net,before:initial,after:clamp(initial+hrs*net,0,max),capacity:max,plant:(loads.greenhouse||0)>=7,air:(loads.lifeSupport||0)>=10,radio:(loads.communications||0)>=4};
}
function instrumentSVG(kind){
 const body={
 lifeSupport:`<circle cx="40" cy="39" r="31" fill="#14394b" stroke="#8bbcd0" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="40" cy="39" r="23" fill="#1b5264" stroke="#6792a4"/><circle cx="40" cy="39" r="7" fill="#c3e9ed"/><path d="M40 32C27 13 19 22 26 35L33 39M47 39C64 26 59 15 45 23L40 32M40 46C52 64 63 57 55 44L47 39M33 39C15 52 21 63 35 55L40 46" fill="#a0d5e2" opacity=".9"/><circle cx="40" cy="39" r="32" fill="none" stroke="#b3deed" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-dasharray="4 8"/>`,
 greenhouse:`<rect x="13" y="15" width="54" height="50" rx="10" fill="#142f34" stroke="#76b8a1" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M19 25H61" stroke="#b0edbb" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/><path d="M40 61V32M40 45C29 29 21 31 22 39C25 47 34 49 40 45ZM40 40C43 25 55 25 59 32C60 39 52 44 40 40Z" fill="#90d5a0" stroke="#afe7b3" stroke-width="1.5"/><rect x="24" y="58" width="32" height="10" rx="3" fill="#b68f72" stroke="#d5b69d"/><path d="M16 12H64" stroke="#b8dded" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>`,
 communications:`<path d="M22 20Q15 37 40 57Q61 38 60 20L41 41Z" fill="#85b6c9" stroke="#cbecf4" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M40 44L48 60H55M48 60L43 69M48 60L58 69" stroke="#a2c9d4" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="23" cy="17" r="4" fill="#d6eceb"/><path d="M19 12Q32 10 33 23M16 7Q39 3 41 24" fill="none" stroke="#91d8eb" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`
 };
 return `<svg viewBox="0 0 80 80" role="img" aria-label="${kind} machine illustration" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">${body[kind]||''}</svg>`;
}
function snapshotSim(){
 const sim=window.Sim;return sim?{battery:sim.batteryCharge,solar:sim.solarGeneration,light:sim.sunIllumination,crop:sim.greenhouseCropHealth,co2:sim.co2Level,oxygen:sim.oxygenLevel,demand:sim.totalDemand,water:sim.potableWaterLitres,heating:sim.powerAllocations.thermalHeaters}:null;
}
class NasaMissionDeck {
 constructor(){this.tab='moon';this.site='rim';this.storm='manual';this.mars='cold';this.marsPlan='insulated';this.visible=false;this.root=null;this.toast='';this.toastLevel='success';this.openedAt=null;
   this.plan={lifeSupport:12,greenhouse:8,communications:5};this.key='moonshift.nasa.deck.v1';this.history=[];
   try{const stored=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(this.key)||'null');if(stored&&stored.version===1&&Array.isArray(stored.history)){this.history=stored.history.slice(-30);if(SITES[stored.site])this.site=stored.site;}}catch(_){}}
 save(){try{localStorage.setItem(this.key,JSON.stringify({version:1,site:this.site,history:this.history.slice(-30)}));}catch(_){} }
 record(type,summary,details){const sim=window.Sim;if(!sim)return;this.history.push({type,summary,details,at:new Date().toISOString(),missionHour:sim.missionTimeHours});this.history=this.history.slice(-30);this.save();window.Story?.decisions?.push({type:'nasaEvidenceMission',task:type,summary,missionHour:sim.missionTimeHours});window.Save?.schedule?.();window.Save?.save?.();window.Beyond?.award?.('nasa-evidence-'+type,50);window.MissionUI?.notify?.('NASA evidence applied to your station · progress saved');}
 activate(){if(this.visible)return;this.visible=true;window.Engine?.clearMovementInput?.();this.plan={lifeSupport:window.Sim?.powerAllocations.lifeSupport||12,greenhouse:window.Sim?.powerAllocations.greenhouse||8,communications:window.Sim?.powerAllocations.communications||5};const r=document.createElement('div');r.className='nx-overlay';r.setAttribute('role','dialog');r.setAttribute('aria-label','NASA Evidence Mission Deck');r.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');this.root=r;document.body.appendChild(r);this.render();r.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===r)this.close()});this._keyHandler=e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){e.stopPropagation();e.preventDefault();this.close()}};document.addEventListener('keydown',this._keyHandler,true);}
 open(tab){if(['moon','power','solar','mars'].includes(tab))this.tab=tab;if(this.visible){this.render();return}this.activate()}
 close(){if(!this.visible)return;this.visible=false;document.removeEventListener('keydown',this._keyHandler,true);this.root?.remove();this.root=null;window.Engine?.clearMovementInput?.();}
 note(message,level='success'){this.toast=message;this.toastLevel=level;const box=$('#nxNotice',this.root);if(box){box.textContent=message;box.dataset.level=level;box.hidden=false;}}
 clearNote(){this.toast='';if(this.root){const box=$('#nxNotice',this.root);if(box){box.hidden=true;box.textContent='';}}}
 render(){if(!this.root)return;this.clearNote();const tabs=[['moon','☾ Lunar sunlight'],['power','⚡ Living systems'],['solar','☀ Solar alert'],['mars','◌ Mars weather']];
   this.root.innerHTML=`<section class="nx-shell" aria-label="Interactive NASA science missions"><header class="nx-top"><div class="nx-brand"><span class="nx-insignia">✦</span><div><span class="nx-overline">MOONSHIFT // NASA EVIDENCE</span><h2>Mission Science Deck</h2></div></div><div class="nx-top-actions"><span class="nx-source-tag">ARCHIVAL DATA · INTERACTIVE SIMULATION</span><button type="button" class="nx-close" aria-label="Return to game">×</button></div></header><nav class="nx-tabs" aria-label="Explore NASA evidence">${tabs.map(([id,label])=>`<button type="button" class="nx-tab" role="tab" data-tab="${id}" aria-selected="${this.tab===id}">${label}</button>`).join('')}</nav><div class="nx-main"><div class="nx-scene"><div class="nx-visual" id="nxVisual"></div><p class="nx-visual-caption" id="nxVisualCaption"></p></div><div class="nx-right" id="nxControls"></div></div><footer class="nx-footer"><span><b>Real observation</b> is never the same as <b>fictional training results</b>. Sources and assumptions are one tap away.</span><span>${this.history.length} experiments recorded · local device only</span></footer></section>`;
   $('.nx-close',this.root).onclick=()=>this.close();this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>{this.tab=btn.dataset.tab;this.render();});this.renderTab();this.root.querySelector('.nx-close').focus({preventScroll:true});}
 setScene(html,caption){$('#nxVisual',this.root).innerHTML=html;$('#nxVisualCaption',this.root).textContent=caption;}
 setControls(html){$('#nxControls',this.root).innerHTML=html+`<p class="nx-message" id="nxNotice" hidden role="status"></p>`;}
 renderTab(){if(this.tab==='moon')return this.renderMoon();if(this.tab==='power')return this.renderPower();if(this.tab==='solar')return this.renderSolar();return this.renderMars();}
 renderMoon(){const sim=window.Sim,site=SITES[this.site],forecast=project(sim,site.light,sim.powerAllocations,1);
   const photo=`<div class="nx-photo-shade"></div><img class="nx-photo" src="${LUNAR_OFFLINE}" alt="Illustrative grayscale lunar terrain while NASA source is loading" loading="eager"><div class="nx-photo-shade"></div><div class="nx-photo-chip">LUNAR TERRAIN ART · VERIFY NASA PHOTOJOURNAL</div><div class="nx-photo-footer"><strong>Where would you build?</strong><span>NASA's historical LROC map is available from the evidence source. Candidate sites are training scenarios, not measured coordinates.</span></div>`;
   this.setScene(photo,'Offline visual: original procedural artwork, not NASA imagery. NASA photojournal PIA13720 (LROC south-pole illumination) is linked in the source panel. Site factors are assumed training inputs.');
   const photoNode=$('.nx-photo',this.root),nasaim=new Image();
   if(photoNode){
    nasaim.onload=()=>{if(!photoNode.isConnected||this.tab!=='moon')return;photoNode.src=SOURCES.lunar.image;photoNode.alt='NASA LROC map of lunar south-pole sunlight frequency, observed from orbit';const chip=$('.nx-photo-chip',this.root);if(chip)chip.textContent='NASA LROC · SOUTH POLE ILLUMINATION MAP';const cap=$('#nxVisualCaption',this.root);if(cap)cap.textContent='NASA photojournal PIA13720 · LROC illumination map. Candidate sites are illustrative categories, not measured coordinates.';};
    nasaim.onerror=()=>{};
    nasaim.src=SOURCES.lunar.image;
   }
   this.setControls(`<span class="nx-overline">01 / VISUAL EVIDENCE → ACTION</span><h3>Find the sunlight. Save your crew.</h3><p class="nx-lead">NASA's LRO mapped changing sunlight around the lunar south pole. Use the real map as evidence, choose a hypothetical habitat site, then watch what happens to the same power grid your crew depends on.</p><div class="nx-factline"><span>1,700 LROC images</span><span>6 lunar days</span><span>88–90° S</span></div><div class="nx-choices">${Object.entries(SITES).map(([id,s])=>choice(id,s.icon,s.name,s.quality,this.site===id)).join('')}</div><div class="nx-snapshot" id="nxStats">${metric('Solar generation',fmt(forecast.solar,1)+' kW')}${metric('Battery in 1 h',fmt(forecast.after,1)+' kWh',forecast.net>=0?'good':'warning')}${metric('Power balance',(forecast.net>=0?'+':'')+fmt(forecast.net,1)+' kW',forecast.net>=0?'good':'warning')}</div><button type="button" class="nx-action" id="nxApply">Use this site in my station →</button><p class="nx-note">Site sunlight factors ${Object.entries(SITES).map(([k,v])=>`${v.name}: ${Math.round(v.light*100)}%`).join(' / ')} are fictional teaching inputs. NASA's map does not supply these numerical values for your fictional sites.</p>${evidence(SOURCES.lunar,'LROC Wide Angle Camera illumination map built from about 1,700 observations; bright/dark terrain indicates relative sun exposure. Site factors above are designer-controlled approximations, not extracted values.')}`);
   this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-choice]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{this.site=b.dataset.choice;this.renderMoon();});$('#nxApply',this.root).onclick=()=>{sim.sunIllumination=site.light;sim.update(0);sim.updateAlerts();this.record('lunarSiting','Selected '+site.name,{factor:site.light,origin:'Training assumption inspired by LROC sunlight mapping'});this.note('Applied! Solar output changed in the real station model. Visit Living Systems to rebalance power.');};
 }
 renderPower(){const sim=window.Sim;if(!sim)return;const p={...sim.powerAllocations,...this.plan};const prediction=project(sim,sim.sunIllumination,p,.5);const batteryPct=Math.round(sim.batteryCharge/sim.batteryCapacityMax*100);
  this.setScene(this.powerArt(p,prediction,batteryPct),'Interactive cutaway: the energy and plant indicators respond to your choices. Plant reactions and energy requirements are fictional training mechanics, not NASA system telemetry.');
  this.setControls(`<span class="nx-overline">02 / ONE STATION, CONNECTED CONSEQUENCES</span><h3>Air, food, and radio share one battery.</h3><p class="nx-lead">Use your current simulation's solar site and stored battery. Experiment freely, then run 30 minutes of simulated station time. A wrong allocation can hurt the greenhouse or CO₂ control.</p><div id="nxPowerRanges">${[['lifeSupport','Life support','kW · aim for ≥ 10',8,18],['greenhouse','Greenhouse lamps','kW · aim for ≥ 7',2,14],['communications','Earth radio','kW · aim for ≥ 4',1,9]].map(([id,label,desc,min,max])=>`<label class="nx-range"><strong>${label} <b id="nxRangeValue-${id}">${this.plan[id]} kW</b></strong><small style="color:#9bbac8">${desc}</small><input type="range" min="${min}" max="${max}" step="1" data-plan="${id}" value="${this.plan[id]}" aria-label="${label} allocation"></label>`).join('')}</div><div class="nx-snapshot" id="nxStats">${metric('Solar supply',fmt(prediction.solar,1)+' kW')}${metric('Demand',fmt(prediction.dem,1)+' kW')}${metric('Battery after 30 min',fmt(prediction.after,1)+' kWh',prediction.after<30?'warning':'good')}</div><button class="nx-action" type="button" id="nxApply">Run this plan for 30 min →</button><p class="nx-note">Simulation inputs use game-defined kW and kWh values. They illustrate the engineering trade-off, not NASA flight hardware requirements.</p>${evidence(SOURCES.life,'NASA documents real oxygen generation, carbon-dioxide removal, water recovery and plant research; all station power and growth rates here remain explicitly simplified game values.',SOURCES.life.secondary)}`);
  this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-plan]').forEach(slider=>slider.oninput=()=>{this.plan[slider.dataset.plan]=Number(slider.value);const tag=$('#nxRangeValue-'+slider.dataset.plan,this.root);if(tag)tag.textContent=slider.value+' kW';const loads={...sim.powerAllocations,...this.plan};const f=project(sim,sim.sunIllumination,loads,.5);const panel=$('#nxStats',this.root);if(panel)panel.innerHTML=`${metric('Solar supply',fmt(f.solar,1)+' kW')}${metric('Demand',fmt(f.dem,1)+' kW')}${metric('Battery after 30 min',fmt(f.after,1)+' kWh',f.after<30?'warning':'good')}`;$('#nxVisual',this.root).innerHTML=this.powerArt(loads,f,batteryPct);});
  $('#nxApply',this.root).onclick=()=>{Object.assign(sim.powerAllocations,this.plan);sim.update(1800);sim.updateAlerts();this.record('powerSystem','Balanced air, greenhouse and radio',{loads:{...sim.powerAllocations},batteryAfter:sim.batteryCharge});const risk=sim.deliveredPower.lifeSupport<10||sim.deliveredPower.greenhouse<7;this.renderPower();this.note((risk?'Warning: a vital system is underpowered. Adjust the sliders and try to recover.':'Station advanced 30 training minutes. Battery, air and plants updated together.'),risk?'warn':'success');};
 }
 powerArt(p,f,batteryPct){return `<div class="nx-station"><div class="nx-station-main">${[['lifeSupport','AIR / O₂',18],['greenhouse','GROW LIGHTS',14],['communications','EARTH SIGNAL',9]].map(([id,label,max])=>`<div class="nx-unit" data-sleep="${id==='lifeSupport'?p[id]<10:id==='greenhouse'?p[id]<7:p[id]<4}"><span class="nx-unit-icon">${instrumentSVG(id)}</span><span class="nx-unit-label">${label}</span><span class="nx-unit-line"><i style="width:${clamp(p[id]/max*100,0,100)}%"></i></span></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="nx-power-path"></div><div class="nx-station-bottom"><div class="nx-battery"><b>${fmt(f.after,1)} <small style="font-size:14px">kWh</small></b><span>AFTER 30-MIN RUN</span><div class="nx-battery-track"><i style="width:${clamp(f.after/f.capacity*100,0,100)}%"></i></div></div><div class="nx-greenhouse" data-bad="${!f.plant}"><span class="nx-plant">${f.plant?'🌿':'🥀'}</span><span>${f.plant?'GREENHOUSE SUPPLIED':'PLANTS NEED MORE LIGHT'}</span></div></div></div>`;}
 renderSolar(){const s=this.storm;
  const art=`<div class="nx-sun-art" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="nx-photo-chip">NASA SDO / DONKI · 14 MAY 2024</div><div class="nx-sun-signal">${SOLAR.map(f=>`<div class="nx-sun-bar"><span>${f.utc} UTC</span><div class="nx-sun-meter"><i style="height:${Math.round(f.value/8.7*100)}%"></i></div><b>${f.label}</b></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
  this.setScene(art,'Historic X-class flare classifications from 14 May 2024. Bar heights compare class numbers for teaching; they are not linear energy, radiation dose, or an astronaut hazard forecast.');
  this.setControls(`<span class="nx-overline">03 / 2024 NASA SPACE-WEATHER ARCHIVE</span><h3>A real solar flare. Your imaginary mission.</h3><p class="nx-lead">NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory recorded an X8.7 flare peaking at 16:51 UTC on May 14, 2024. A flare is NOT the same thing as a measured radiation dose at a lunar habitat. Prepare for a hypothetical crew-protection drill inspired by this event.</p><div class="nx-factline"><span>Historic: 14 May 2024</span><span>Peak: X8.7</span><span>NASA / SDO</span></div><div class="nx-choices">${choice('manual','🔧','Manual shutter inspection','1 kWh training cost · slower preparation',s==='manual')}${choice('powered','🛡','Powered shelter shutters','6 kWh training cost · rapid closure',s==='powered')}${choice('ignore','⚠','Ignore the warning','Unsafe training outcome · see why',s==='ignore')}</div><div class="nx-snapshot">${metric('Battery reserve',fmt(window.Sim?.batteryCharge||0,1)+' kWh')}${metric('Training cost',s==='powered'?'6 kWh':s==='manual'?'1 kWh':'0 kWh')}${metric('Case study','X8.7')}</div><button type="button" class="nx-action" id="nxApply">Run the shelter drill →</button><p class="nx-note">No flight radiation forecast is generated. The shielding response, cost, and crew-risk outcomes are fictional teaching scenarios, not a computation from X8.7.</p>${evidence(SOURCES.solar,'NASA reported an X8.7 flare at 12:51 p.m. US Eastern Daylight Time (16:51 UTC). Other classification events on this date are from the NASA CCMC archival report; classes do not directly determine lunar surface dose.',SOURCES.solar.secondary)}`);
  this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-choice]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{this.storm=b.dataset.choice;this.renderSolar();});$('#nxApply',this.root).onclick=()=>{if(s==='ignore'){this.note('That plan is not safe. Solar-flare strength alone does not predict a local radiation dose, but crew shelters should be ready during an alert. Choose a protection plan.','warn');return;}const sim=window.Sim,cost=s==='manual'?1:6;if(sim.batteryCharge<cost){this.note('Stored energy is too low. Rebalance your power first.','warn');return;}sim.batteryCharge-=cost;sim.stormShelterShieldLocked=true;sim.solarStormActive=true;sim.update(300);sim.solarStormActive=false;sim.update(0);sim.updateAlerts();this.record('solarShelter',s==='manual'?'Manual shelter drill':'Powered shelter drill',{historicalFlare:'2024-05-14 X8.7',shield:true,costKWh:cost,fictionalScenario:true});this.renderSolar();this.note(`Training drill complete. Crew shelter secured, ${cost} kWh spent. No real astronaut dose was inferred.`);};
 }
 renderMars(){const obs=REMS[this.mars],p=this.marsPlan;
  this.setScene(`<div class="nx-photo-chip">NASA CURIOSITY / REMS · ARCHIVED OBSERVATIONS</div><div class="nx-thermo"><div class="nx-thermo-band"><i style="left:${this.mars==='cold'?'8%':'88%'}"></i></div><div class="nx-thermo-card"><span class="nx-overline">MARS YEAR 31 · SOL ${obs.sol}</span><strong>${fmt(obs.celcius,2)} °C</strong><small>${obs.label}. Published REMS-derived record, converted from ${fmt(obs.kelvin,2)} K.</small></div></div><div class="nx-thermo-bottom"><div><b>688.88 Pa</b><small>Lowest pressure listed · MY31 sol 22</small></div><div><b>969.13 Pa</b><small>Highest pressure listed · MY31 sol 163</small></div></div>`,'REMS-derived air temperature and atmospheric pressure extrema are from different sols. Do not interpret them as one daily forecast, one location, or current weather.');
  const costs={insulated:5,heater:13,none:1};const cost=costs[p];const battery=window.Sim?.batteryCharge||0;
  this.setControls(`<span class="nx-overline">04 / MARS ARCHIVED ATMOSPHERE</span><h3>Design a shelter for extreme cold.</h3><p class="nx-lead">NASA's Curiosity rover measured Martian weather with the REMS instrument. Here are two published historical air-temperature extremes from different sols. Pick an observation, then decide how a fictional Mars habitat might balance insulation and heater electricity.</p><div class="nx-choices">${choice('cold','❄','190.69 K · −82.46°C','Sol 329 · recorded minimum air temperature in MY31',this.mars==='cold')}${choice('mild','☀','269.53 K · −3.62°C','Sol 164 · recorded maximum air temperature in MY31',this.mars==='mild')}</div><p class="nx-lead" style="margin-bottom:7px"><b>Choose your engineering plan</b> (illustrative energy costs)</p><div class="nx-choices">${choice('insulated','🏠','Seal, insulate and heat efficiently','5 kWh · protects resources (training)',p==='insulated')}${choice('heater','🔥','Run the heaters at full output','13 kWh · high battery cost (training)',p==='heater')}${choice('none','🌬','Save power by disabling heat','1 kWh · crew temperature risk (training)',p==='none')}</div><div class="nx-snapshot">${metric('Observed air',fmt(obs.celcius,1)+' °C')}${metric('Plan cost',cost+' kWh')}${metric('Battery after',fmt(clamp(battery-cost,0,window.Sim?.batteryCapacityMax||250),1)+' kWh',battery<cost?'warning':'good')}</div><button type="button" class="nx-action" id="nxApply">Test the habitat plan →</button><p class="nx-note">The 5/13/1 kWh costs and modeled cabin temperatures are invented learning values. Mars weather data does not determine those numbers.</p>${evidence(SOURCES.mars,'Temperatures are observed extrema in Kelvin from a peer-reviewed analysis of Curiosity REMS measurements (MY31; sol 329 low and sol 164 high). Pressure extrema are other sols. Celsius = Kelvin minus 273.15; the illustration is not a current forecast.',SOURCES.mars.secondary)}`);
  this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-choice]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const id=b.dataset.choice;if(id in REMS)this.mars=id;else this.marsPlan=id;this.renderMars();});$('#nxApply',this.root).onclick=()=>{if(p==='none'){this.note('No heating would put this fictional crew at risk. Try insulation and smart power instead.','warn');return;}const sim=window.Sim;if(sim.batteryCharge<cost){this.note('Insufficient battery reserve. Rebalance your station before applying this plan.','warn');return;}sim.batteryCharge-=cost;sim.setPowerAllocation('thermalHeaters',p==='heater'?12:7);sim.update(900);sim.updateAlerts();this.record('marsClimate',`Thermal strategy: ${p}`,{observedSol:obs.sol,observedKelvin:obs.kelvin,trainingEnergyCostKWh:cost});this.renderMars();this.note('Mars historical evidence reviewed. Fifteen minutes of fictional cabin operation simulated and saved.');};
 }
}
function install(){if(window.NasaMissionLab)return;const deck=new NasaMissionDeck();window.NasaMissionLab=deck;window.NasaMissionSources=SOURCES;
 const bar=$('.hud-actions-group');if(bar&&!$('#nasaEvidenceBtn')){const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='hud-btn';b.id='nasaEvidenceBtn';b.title='Real NASA evidence and connected station experiments';b.type='button';b.innerHTML='✦ <span>NASA LAB</span>';b.onclick=()=>deck.open('moon');const before=$('#beUniverseBtn')||$('#missionMenuBtn');bar.insertBefore(b,before||null);}
 const ui=window.MissionUI;if(ui&&!ui._nxEvidenceInstalled){ui._nxEvidenceInstalled=true;const activities=ui.showActivities.bind(ui);ui.showActivities=function(...args){const ret=activities(...args);const list=$('.mission-guide-overlay .activity-list')||$('.activity-list');if(list&&!$('#nxActivityEntry',list)){const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.type='button';btn.id='nxActivityEntry';btn.className='activity-choice';btn.innerHTML='<span class="activity-icon">✦</span><span class="activity-copy"><strong>NASA Evidence Missions</strong><small>Study real lunar sunlight, past solar activity and Mars weather. Make your choice affect station systems.</small></span><span class="activity-go">EXPLORE ↗</span>';btn.onclick=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.mission-guide-overlay').forEach(n=>{(n.closest('.task-overlay')||n).remove()});deck.open('moon')};list.prepend(btn);}return ret;};}
 const games=window.Minigames;if(games&&!games._nxEvidenceInstalled){games._nxEvidenceInstalled=true;const start=games.startTask.bind(games);games.startTask=function(id,...args){const result=start(id,...args);const lab=$('.v23-lab');if(lab&&!$('.nx-lab-evidence',lab)){const button=document.createElement('button');button.className='nx-lab-evidence';button.type='button';button.textContent='✦ EXPLORE REAL NASA DATA';button.style.cssText='display:inline-flex;margin:9px 2px 2px;max-width:100%;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid #8ebdcb;border-radius:12px;background:#21465a;color:#def4f9;font:750 11px system-ui;cursor:pointer';const head=$('.v23-header',lab)||$('.v23-footer',lab)||lab;head.appendChild(button);button.onclick=()=>{games.close();deck.open(id==='stormShutter'?'solar':id==='greenhouseLight'?'power':id==='roverSurvey'?'moon':id==='powerRouting'?'moon':'power')};}return result;};}
 const save=window.Save;if(save&&!save._nxEvidenceReset){save._nxEvidenceReset=true;const reset=save.reset.bind(save);save.reset=function(...args){const result=reset(...args);if(result){try{localStorage.removeItem(deck.key)}catch(_){ }deck.history=[];deck.site='rim';}return result;};}
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',install,{once:true});else install();
})();
</script>
<style>
.task-overlay .task-modal.v25-enhanced-task{max-width:min(820px,96vw);border-radius:23px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 8% 0%,#24475c 0,transparent 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,#142c3e,#0a1b2b 78%);border:1px solid rgba(153,205,220,.35);box-shadow:0 28px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.72);overflow:hidden}

.v25-enhanced-task .valve-node{min-width:100px;width:min(140px,30%);padding:13px 6px;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s;cursor:pointer}
.v25-enhanced-task .valve-node:hover,.v25-enhanced-task .valve-node:focus-visible{background:#28546a;border-color:#b4e7ed;outline:none}

.v25-enhanced-task .co2-monitor-box,.v25-enhanced-task .power-summary-box,.v25-enhanced-task .dosimeter-box{gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;line-height:1.5;border:1px solid rgba(125,176,194,.22);border-radius:13px;background:rgba(10,28,42,.65)}
.v25-enhanced-task .rover-route.selected{border-color:#a4e7e1;background:#25495c}

.v23-lab{box-shadow:0 28px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.65)!important}
.v23-card,.v23-graphic,.v23-grid-controls .v23-ctrl{transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s}
.v23-grid-controls .v23-ctrl:hover{border-color:#afdce6!important;transform:translateY(-1px)}
@media(max-width:730px){.v25-science-stage{padding:9px 10px 7px;border-radius:13px}.v25-kicker{font-size:9px}.v25-stage-caption{font-size:10px}.v25-enhanced-task .task-body{padding:13px}.v25-enhanced-task .task-footer{padding:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.v25-enhanced-task .task-footer-actions{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}.v25-enhanced-task .task-hint{max-width:100%;width:100%}.v25-enhanced-task .valve-title{font-size:9px}.v25-enhanced-task .valve-state{font-size:9px}.v25-enhanced-task .task-action-btn{font-size:11px}.v25-enhanced-task .scrubber-schematic{padding:10px 0}.v25-enhanced-task .valve-node{padding:9px 3px}.v25-stage-picture{min-height:120px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v25-enhanced-task *,.v23-lab *{transition:none!important}}

.v25-science-stage [data-v25-step],.v25-science-stage [data-v25-aim]{cursor:pointer;outline:none}.v25-science-stage [data-v25-step]:hover circle,.v25-science-stage [data-v25-step]:focus-visible circle,.v25-science-stage [data-v25-aim]:focus-visible{stroke:#f9d7aa;stroke-width:5}
.hud-interact-prompt{max-width:min(92vw,760px)!important;justify-content:center;gap:12px!important;text-align:center}.hud-interact-prompt strong{display:inline-block;max-width:min(66vw,520px);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;vertical-align:bottom}.key-pill{transform:translateY(-.5px)}
.v25-science-stage svg{shape-rendering:geometricPrecision}.v25-stage-picture,.nx-scene-wrap img{image-rendering:auto}
.v25-stage-picture{position:relative;border:1px solid rgba(120,179,203,.18);border-radius:18px;padding:10px 12px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 22%,rgba(74,140,169,.16),transparent 30%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(9,28,41,.92),rgba(7,21,33,.96));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.03),0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
.v25-stage-picture::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(118,170,194,.08) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(118,170,194,.08) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:36px 36px;opacity:.32;pointer-events:none}.v25-stage-picture>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.v25-stage-caption a{color:#9ad9e6;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none}.v25-stage-caption a:hover{text-decoration:underline}

</style><script>
/* MOONSHIFT V25 — integrated station art and richer existing-mission instruments.
   Progressive enhancement: existing story/task logic remains authoritative. */
(()=>{
 'use strict';
 const ICONS={co2Scrubber:'AIR REGENERATION',waterRecovery:'WATER RECOVERY',dsnAlign:'EARTH RELAY',gravityLab:'GRAVITY DROP',roverSurvey:'ROVER FIELD SURVEY',thermalBalance:'THERMAL SYSTEM',evaMission:'SAMPLE DRILL'};
 const LINKS={co2Scrubber:'https://www.nasa.gov/reference/environmental-control-and-life-support-systems-eclss/',waterRecovery:'https://www.nasa.gov/reference/environmental-control-and-life-support-systems-eclss/',dsnAlign:'https://www.nasa.gov/communicating-with-missions/dsn/',gravityLab:'https://science.nasa.gov/moon/facts/',roverSurvey:'https://science.nasa.gov/mission/lro/',thermalBalance:'https://www.nasa.gov/reference/environmental-control-and-life-support-systems-eclss/',evaMission:'https://science.nasa.gov/moon/'};
 const labels={co2Scrubber:'Clean cabin air while keeping the recirculation system active.',waterRecovery:'Trace reclaimed water through every treatment and verification stage.',dsnAlign:'Point the dish, confirm its signal, and send telemetry to Earth.',gravityLab:'Watch equal objects move under different gravitational accelerations.',roverSurvey:'Trade rover battery energy for scientific discoveries.',thermalBalance:'Balance cabin warmth with electricity shared by the whole outpost.',evaMission:'Sample a fictional training site using a safe drilling window.'};
 const safe=(n,d=1)=>Number.isFinite(Number(n))?Number(n).toFixed(d):'--';
 const glow='#93dae8';
 const el=(tag,attrs={},html='')=>{const e=document.createElement(tag);for(const [k,v]of Object.entries(attrs))e.setAttribute(k,v);if(html)e.innerHTML=html;return e;};
 function sceneFor(id){
   const sim=window.Sim||{};
   const status=(id==='co2Scrubber')?['st1','st2','st3'].map(k=>document.getElementById(k)?.textContent||'READY'):
      (id==='waterRecovery')?[...document.querySelectorAll('.water-stage-card')].map(n=>n.textContent):[];
   
   const stages=['VENT','HEAT','SWITCH'];
   if(id==='co2Scrubber'){
     const count=status.filter((s,i)=>s&&(!/SEALED|OFFLINE|SATURATED/i.test(s))).length;
     return `<svg viewBox="0 0 650 205" role="img" aria-label="Interactive cabin air loop with three processing stages"><defs><linearGradient id="v25air" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#254e61"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#0a2638"/></linearGradient></defs><path d="M75 103H573" stroke="#1e4357" stroke-width="31" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M75 103H${75+Math.min(1,count/3)*498}" stroke="#76d4de" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="14 12"/><g>${[0,1,2].map((i)=>`<g data-v25-step="${i+1}" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Activate ${stages[i]}" transform="translate(${108+i*217},103)"><circle r="48" fill="url(#v25air)" stroke="${i<count?'#9aebcb':'#607f8e'}" stroke-width="3"/><text y="10" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" fill="#d9f6fa" font-weight="800">${i<count?'✓':i===0?'↻':i===1?'♨':'⇄'}</text><text y="72" text-anchor="middle" fill="#c5dbe5" font-size="14">${stages[i]}</text></g>`).join('')}</g><text x="325" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="#d8f5fa" font-size="15">AIRFLOW CONTROL · ${safe(sim.co2Level,0)} ppm CO₂</text><text x="325" y="198" text-anchor="middle" fill="#89c9d8" font-size="12">${count} / 3 stages prepared · learning scenario, not a live crew sensor</text></svg>`;
   }
   if(id==='waterRecovery'){
     const done=[...document.querySelectorAll('.water-stage-card')].filter(x=>/DONE|COMPLETE|✓|PURIFIED|PASS/.test(x.textContent)).length;
     return `<svg viewBox="0 0 650 205" role="img" aria-label="Water treatment pathway and purifier modules"><defs><linearGradient id="v25water" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#184259"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#10283a"/></linearGradient></defs><path d="M60 115H596" stroke="#17384e" stroke-width="24" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M60 115H${60+Math.min(done/4,1)*536}" stroke="#65d3e9" stroke-width="10" stroke-dasharray="12 8"/>${['SEPARATE','FILTER','CLEAN','TEST'].map((t,i)=>`<g data-v25-step="${i+1}" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Activate ${t} stage" transform="translate(${91+i*153},106)"><rect x="-44" y="-47" width="88" height="90" rx="14" fill="url(#v25water)" stroke="${i<done?'#8de5cd':'#678ea3'}" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M-30 0q30 -15 60 0v24q-30 12-60 0z" fill="${i<done?'#68cdd8':'#336279'}" opacity=".85"/><text y="-9" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="850" font-size="18" fill="#eaf9ff">${i<done?'✓':i+1}</text><text y="69" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#c8e3e9">${t}</text></g>`).join('')}<text x="325" y="22" text-anchor="middle" fill="#e2f5ff" font-size="14">CLOSED-LOOP WATER RECOVERY · ${done}/4 STAGES</text></svg>`;
   }
   if(id==='dsnAlign'){
     const az=Number(document.querySelector('#dishAz')?.value??184);
     const elev=Number(document.querySelector('#dishEl')?.value??43);
     const dx=az-184,dy=elev-43;
     const dist=Math.hypot(dx*1.5,dy*1.5),aligned=dist<4;
     const sim=window.Sim||{};
     const grid=sim.powerAllocations||{};
     const loads=Object.values(grid).reduce((n,v)=>n+(Number(v)||0),0);
     const powerOK=Number(grid.communications||0)>=4 && !(sim.batteryCharge<=.001 && sim.solarGeneration<loads);
     const state=aligned?(powerOK?'READY TO TRANSMIT':'ALIGNED · NEED POWER'):(dist<15?'APPROACHING':'SEARCHING');
     const tone=aligned?(powerOK?'#99e7c5':'#f0c789'):(dist<15?'#f2c583':'#8bcde2');
     const px=503+Math.max(-110,Math.min(110,dx*3.2));
     const py=86-Math.max(-52,Math.min(52,dy*2.1));
     const quality=Math.max(0,Math.round((1-Math.min(dist,70)/70)*100));
     return `<svg viewBox="0 0 650 205" role="img" aria-label="Antenna alignment training instrument, azimuth ${az} degrees, elevation ${elev} degrees; ${state}">
       <defs><linearGradient id="v322panel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#102b40"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#0b1d2b"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="v322beam" x1="0" x2="1"><stop stop-color="#61bcd9" stop-opacity=".26"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="${tone}" stop-opacity=".90"/></linearGradient></defs>
       <rect x="11" y="9" width="628" height="186" rx="18" fill="url(#v322panel)" stroke="#375a6c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
       <text x="28" y="30" fill="#a3cbd8" font-size="11" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="1.4">EARTH RELAY · TRAINING SIMULATION</text>
       <rect x="446" y="17" width="166" height="27" rx="13" fill="#183844" stroke="${tone}" stroke-opacity=".5"/>
       <circle cx="461" cy="30" r="4" fill="${tone}"/><text x="472" y="34" fill="${tone}" font-size="11" font-weight="800">${state}</text>
       <path d="M172 126L${px} ${py}" stroke="url(#v322beam)" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".28"/>
       <path d="M172 126L${px} ${py}" stroke="${tone}" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-dasharray="${aligned?'0':'8 8'}" stroke-linecap="round"/>
       <path d="M504 86l-22 -24a34 34 0 0 1 44 0z" fill="none" stroke="#4b93ac" opacity=".55"/>
       <circle cx="503" cy="86" r="37" fill="none" stroke="#517489" stroke-dasharray="3 7"/>
       <circle cx="503" cy="86" r="25" fill="#17577b" stroke="#9ccbdc" stroke-width="2"/>
       <path d="M489 68L506 72L501 84L517 90L512 105L494 99L489 88Z" fill="#8dc9a4"/>
       <circle cx="503" cy="86" r="35" data-v25-aim="true" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Aim the antenna at Earth" fill="transparent" stroke="${aligned?'#8fdeb6':'#84b5cb'}" stroke-width="1.6"/>
       <path d="M172 129L113 91Q166 56 226 93Z" fill="#5d91aa" stroke="#c5e8ee" stroke-width="2.2"/><path d="M173 120V161M138 164H207" stroke="#b2d4dd" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="173" cy="120" r="6" fill="#e7c68a"/>
       <path d="M135 88Q174 65 214 89" stroke="#9fcfe0" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity=".48"/>
       <text x="59" y="66" fill="#d0e9f0" font-size="13" font-weight="750">Dish az ${az}°</text>
       <text x="59" y="84" fill="#aacbd7" font-size="12">Elevation ${elev}°</text>
       <text x="388" y="146" text-anchor="middle" fill="#b7d6e1" font-size="12">Angle error ${Math.hypot(dx,dy).toFixed(1)}°</text>
       <rect x="335" y="157" width="225" height="7" rx="4" fill="#203d4d"/>
       <rect x="335" y="157" width="${quality*2.25}" height="7" rx="4" fill="${tone}"/>
       <text x="447" y="181" fill="#aacbd7" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11">Pointing quality · ${quality}%</text>
       <text x="50" y="186" fill="${powerOK?'#a7e4cc':'#e9c89a'}" font-size="11">Radio power · ${Number(grid.communications||0).toFixed(1)} / 4.0 kW</text>
     </svg>`;
   }
   if(id==='gravityLab'){
     const earth=document.getElementById('earthTime')?.textContent||'Ready';const moon=document.getElementById('moonTime')?.textContent||'Ready';
     return `<svg viewBox="0 0 650 205" role="img" aria-label="Earth and Moon gravity illustrated"><defs><linearGradient id="v25grav"><stop stop-color="#183f5d"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#0e293e"/></linearGradient></defs><rect x="25" y="16" width="600" height="166" rx="18" fill="url(#v25grav)"/><path d="M65 147H585" stroke="#7796aa" stroke-width="3"/>${[205,445].map((x,i)=>`<path d="M${x} 40v100" stroke="#6d98ab" stroke-dasharray="6 7"/><circle cx="${x}" cy="${(i?moon:earth).includes('Landed')?132:66}" r="17" fill="${i?'#b5a3d8':'#8bd3e9'}" stroke="#e4eff8" stroke-width="2"/><text x="${x}" y="27" text-anchor="middle" fill="#eff9fd" font-size="16">${i?'MOON 1.62 m/s²':'EARTH 9.81 m/s²'}</text>`).join('')}<text x="325" y="197" text-anchor="middle" fill="#a8d9e5" font-size="13">Same release height; simplified vacuum-physics experiment</text></svg>`;
   }
   if(id==='roverSurvey'){
     const selected=document.querySelector('.rover-route.selected')?.dataset?.route||'short';
     const moonSrc=window.SpaceArt?.urls?.moon||'';
     return `<svg viewBox="0 0 650 205" role="img" aria-label="Illustrated rover route crossing a lunar ridge"><defs><linearGradient id="v25reg" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#132b40"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#3b4550"/></linearGradient></defs><rect x="20" y="15" width="610" height="171" rx="18" fill="url(#v25reg)"/>${moonSrc?`<image href="${moonSrc}" x="527" y="29" width="56" height="56" opacity=".9"/>`:`<circle cx="555" cy="57" r="27" fill="#b4c5d6" opacity=".8"/>`}<path d="M30 141L128 125L203 138L284 96L354 124L434 87L620 125V177H30z" fill="#60717e"/><path d="M44 157Q195 119 290 137T565 105" fill="none" stroke="#f4cd95" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="9 9"/><g transform="translate(${selected==='short'?185:selected==='ridge'?330:512},119)"><rect x="-29" y="-25" width="59" height="28" rx="9" fill="#bad5dc" stroke="#e4edf3" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="-19" cy="7" r="10" fill="#1c2833" stroke="#a7bfcc" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="22" cy="7" r="10" fill="#1c2833" stroke="#a7bfcc" stroke-width="3"/></g><text x="56" y="38" fill="#cfe8f1" font-size="16">LUNAR SURVEY</text><text x="325" y="199" text-anchor="middle" fill="#b8dce8" font-size="12">Route preview · not NASA rover tracking</text></svg>`;
   }
   if(id==='thermalBalance'){
     const kw=Number(document.querySelector('#thermoPower')?.value??sim.powerAllocations?.thermalHeaters??5);
     const t=19.7+(kw-3)*.48;
     return `<svg viewBox="0 0 650 205" role="img" aria-label="Thermal cabin heat flow and insulation"><defs><linearGradient id="v25heat"><stop stop-color="#5789af"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#e4a46f"/></linearGradient></defs><rect x="30" y="20" width="590" height="150" rx="22" fill="#0d2435" stroke="#577f94" stroke-width="3"/><rect x="92" y="44" width="467" height="107" rx="18" fill="#183649" stroke="#a0c0ca" stroke-width="6"/><path d="M150 120q25-50 51 0t51 0t51 0t51 0t51 0" fill="none" stroke="url(#v25heat)" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="326" y="81" text-anchor="middle" fill="#eaf5f8" font-size="27" font-weight="800">${safe(t,1)}°C</text><text x="325" y="196" text-anchor="middle" fill="#bddce4" font-size="13">Heater ${kw} kW · fictional cabin model</text></svg>`;
   }
   if(id==='evaMission'){
     const value=Number(document.getElementById('meterNeedle')?.style.left?.replace('%',''))||0;
     return `<svg viewBox="0 0 650 205" role="img" aria-label="Lunar sample drill and depth illustration"><rect x="22" y="16" width="606" height="174" rx="19" fill="#102536"/><path d="M28 107q85-36 165-11t152-7t143 1t138-10v95H28z" fill="#6b7276"/><path d="M28 141q96-32 203-12t208-13t186-8v68H28z" fill="#515e6c"/><path d="M325 53v88" stroke="#cce4ed" stroke-width="11"/><path d="M312 134l13 25 13-25z" fill="#9fe4ee"/><rect x="249" y="20" width="152" height="19" rx="10" fill="#223e51"/><rect x="249" y="20" width="${Math.min(1,Math.max(0,value/100))*152}" height="19" rx="10" fill="${value>=38&&value<=68?'#92d9b1':'#e8b777'}"/><text x="325" y="194" text-anchor="middle" fill="#c3e2ec" font-size="13">Illustrated sample site · ice results are fictional</text></svg>`;
   }
   return '';
 }
 function addStage(id,modal){
   const body=modal.querySelector('#taskBody');if(!body||body.querySelector('.v25-science-stage'))return;
   modal.classList.add('v25-enhanced-task');
   const stage=el('section',{class:'v25-science-stage','aria-label':'Interactive system visualizer'});
   stage.innerHTML=`<div class="v25-stage-top"><span class="v25-kicker">FIELD INSTRUMENT · ${ICONS[id]}</span><span class="v25-live"><i></i> SIMULATION</span></div><div class="v25-stage-picture" role="presentation"></div><p class="v25-stage-caption">${labels[id]} <a href="${LINKS[id]}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">NASA science ↗</a></p>`;
   body.prepend(stage);
   let prev='';let stopped=false;let tick=0;
   const refresh=()=>{if(stopped||!modal.isConnected)return;const now=Date.now();if(now-tick<240)return;tick=now;
     const s=sceneFor(id);if(s&&s!==prev){stage.querySelector('.v25-stage-picture').innerHTML=s;prev=s;}
   };
   refresh();const timer=setInterval(refresh,330);
   const controls=stage.querySelector('.v25-stage-picture');
   controls.addEventListener('click',ev=>{
     const step=ev.target.closest('[data-v25-step]');
     if(step){const i=Number(step.dataset.v25Step);if(id==='co2Scrubber')document.getElementById('valve'+i)?.click();else if(id==='waterRecovery')document.getElementById('btn_w'+i)?.click();refresh();return;}
     if(id==='dsnAlign'&&ev.target.closest('[data-v25-aim]')){
       const az=document.getElementById('dishAz'),elev=document.getElementById('dishEl');
       if(az&&elev){az.value='184';elev.value='43';az.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));elev.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));refresh();}
     }
   });
   controls.addEventListener('keydown',ev=>{if(ev.key!=='Enter'&&ev.key!==' ')return;const item=ev.target.closest('[data-v25-step],[data-v25-aim]');if(item){ev.preventDefault();item.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true}));}});
   const clean=()=>{stopped=true;clearInterval(timer)};
   window.MoonshiftV25._currentCleanup?.();window.MoonshiftV25._currentCleanup=clean;
   modal.querySelector('#taskCloseBtn')?.addEventListener('click',clean,{once:true});
   stage.querySelector('a')?.addEventListener('click',e=>e.stopPropagation());
 }
 function installTasks(){const game=window.Minigames;if(!game)return false;
   if(!game.close.__v25Art){const oldClose=game.close.bind(game);const wrappedClose=function(...args){window.MoonshiftV25?._currentCleanup?.();if(window.MoonshiftV25)window.MoonshiftV25._currentCleanup=null;return oldClose(...args)};wrappedClose.__v25Art=true;game.close=wrappedClose;}
   if(game.startTask.__v25Art)return true;
   const old=game.startTask.bind(game);
   const wrappedStart=function(id,...args){const result=old(id,...args);if(!ICONS[id])return result;
     const modal=document.querySelector('.task-overlay .task-modal:not(.v23-lab)');
     if(modal)addStage(id,modal);return result;
   };wrappedStart.__v25Art=true;game.startTask=wrappedStart;game._v25Installed=true;
   return true;
 }
 function addStationArt(){const map=window.StationMap;if(!map||map._v25ArtInstalled)return false;map._v25ArtInstalled=true;
   const previous=map.renderFurniture.bind(map);
   const cache=new Map();
   const staticArt=(room)=>{
     const b=room.bounds, w=b.w,h=b.h,world=map.currentWorld||'moon',key=room.id+':'+world;
     if(cache.has(key))return cache.get(key);
     const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;
     const g=c.getContext('2d');
     const rect=(x,y,ww,hh,fill,stroke=null,r=7)=>{g.beginPath();g.roundRect(x,y,ww,hh,r);g.fillStyle=fill;g.fill();if(stroke){g.strokeStyle=stroke;g.lineWidth=2;g.stroke()}};
     const stripe=(x,y,ww,color)=>{rect(x,y,ww,4,color,null,2)};
     const glass=(x,y,ww,hh,accent)=>{g.save();g.shadowColor='rgba(0,0,0,.33)';g.shadowBlur=12;g.shadowOffsetY=6;rect(x,y,ww,hh,'#0b2331', '#526b79',11);g.shadowBlur=0;g.shadowOffsetY=0;const grad=g.createLinearGradient(x,y,x+ww,y+hh);grad.addColorStop(0,'#214b61');grad.addColorStop(.6,'#142f40');grad.addColorStop(1,'#0c2739');rect(x+6,y+7,ww-12,hh-14,grad,'#3c677c',7);stripe(x+15,y+14,ww-30,accent);g.restore();};
     const led=(x,y,color)=>{g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,4.5,0,Math.PI*2);g.fillStyle=color;g.fill()};
     const text=(x,y,t,size=11,color='#d2e5ed')=>{g.fillStyle=color;g.font=`700 ${size}px system-ui,sans-serif`;g.fillText(t,x,y)};
     const panelDetails=(x,y,ww)=>{for(let j=0;j<4;j++){rect(x+15+j*(ww-30)/4,y+38,(ww-50)/5,15,'#1b4050','#456a78',3);led(x+22+j*(ww-30)/4,y+29,j===1?'#a9d9b1':'#84bfce');}};
     // Fixtures are along room walls. The traversable floor is deliberately clear.
     if(room.id==='dock'){
       glass(20,173,135,114,'#80d2e5');panelDetails(20,173,135);text(30,265,'CREW ARRIVAL',10);
       glass(w-155,173,135,114,'#e3c68c');panelDetails(w-155,173,135);text(w-142,265,'SHUTTLE LINK',10);
       for(let i=0;i<5;i++){rect(201+i*29,46,13,34,'#344e5f','#6c8b98',3);led(207+i*29,87,i%2?'#79bfac':'#b9b88f');}
       for(let i=0;i<3;i++){rect(195+i*49,h-68,32,26,'#344a56','#506c79',5);stripe(201+i*49,h-60,19,'#97bac2');}
       text(186,32,'PRESSURIZATION SEQUENCE',10);
     }else if(room.id==='centralHab'){
       glass(226,65,298,55,'#8de0df');text(246,104,'MISSION OPERATIONS   ·   LUNA-7',13);
       for(let i=0;i<2;i++){glass(265+i*102,h-112,83,59,'#b9d9de');text(280+i*102,h-75,i?'TECH':'CREW',10);}
       // Luminous navigational arrows embedded in floor rather than UI overlays.
       for(let i=0;i<3;i++){g.strokeStyle='rgba(158,196,208,.15)';g.lineWidth=2;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(162+i*72,190);g.lineTo(172+i*72,200);g.lineTo(162+i*72,210);g.stroke();}
     }else if(room.id==='power'){
       for(let i=0;i<4;i++){glass(44+i*133,70,100,48,'#e9b879');text(62+i*133,101,`CELL ${i+1}`,12);}
       glass(94,h-188,w-188,44,'#e3b56e');text(117,h-158,'SOLAR DISTRIBUTION BUS',13);
       for(let i=0;i<4;i++){g.strokeStyle='rgba(227,181,110,.2)';g.lineWidth=5;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(102+i*117,267);g.lineTo(102+i*117,312);g.stroke();}
     }else if(room.id==='lifeSupport'){
       glass(195,70,250,57,'#8ed3e4');text(217,107,'ECLSS · CLOSED LOOP',13);
       for(let i=0;i<5;i++){g.fillStyle=['#74b3c9','#93e2e2','#83bdd2','#8edace','#6fb0bf'][i];rect(38+i*122,319,87,14,'#183e50','#497486',4);stripe(47+i*122,323,69,g.fillStyle)}
       glass(211,h-181,210,45,'#8bceda');text(226,h-152,'WATER & AIR SYSTEM',12);
     }else if(room.id==='greenhouse'){
       if(world==='orbit'){glass(248,87,208,54,'#89c7dd');text(270,119,'DOCKING AIRLOCK',13);}
       else {
         for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
           const x=154+i*280;glass(x,72,192,34,'#95dbae');
           for(let j=0;j<7;j++){stripe(x+16+j*24,96,16,j%2?'#9fe5ce':'#d3b1de');}
           text(x+52,64,world==='mars'?'HABITAT CROPS':'HYDROPONICS',10);
         }
         glass(237,h-156,227,38,'#94d4b0');text(254,h-130,'GROWTH MONITOR',13);
       }
     }else if(room.id==='comms'){
       glass(225,64,218,114,'#88d8e5');
       for(let i=0;i<4;i++){g.strokeStyle='rgba(139,219,235,.43)';g.lineWidth=2;g.beginPath();g.arc(331,123,19+i*15,Math.PI*1.12,Math.PI*1.93);g.stroke();}
       led(333,134,'#8debbf');text(263,162,'EARTH TRACKER',12);
       stripe(42,232,w-84,'#74bccf');
     }else if(room.id==='quarters'){
       for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const x=48+i*170;glass(x,305,116,61,'#d2ba99');text(x+23,342,`CREW ${i+1}`,12);}
       glass(210,71,177,51,'#e0bd8c');text(229,102,'PERSONAL LOGS',12);
     }else if(room.id==='shelter'){
       glass(212,73,180,87,'#d18d88');text(230,111,'CREW SAFE ZONE',12);
       for(let i=0;i<3;i++){rect(74+i*160,220,95,39,'#244352','#6b838c',10);stripe(88+i*160,232,65,'#c49e89');text(89+i*160,253,'LOCK '+(i+1),10);}
     }else if(room.id==='observation'){
       glass(28,115,148,78,'#96d0e0');text(44,160,world==='mars'?'MARS SKY':'TELESCOPE',11);
       glass(w-180,115,147,78,'#d7c298');text(w-164,160,'FIELD LOG',11);
       for(let i=0;i<7;i++){rect(124+i*73,h-96,38,7,'#4e6f80',null,3);}
     }else if(room.id==='airlock'){
       glass(20,61,176,50,'#e5bb80');text(32,93,'AIRLOCK STATUS',13);
       glass(w-184,61,164,50,'#95ced9');text(w-173,93,'EVA PROCEDURE',11);
       for(let i=0;i<3;i++){rect(183+i*56,h-135,38,44,'#375261','#7696a2',6);stripe(192+i*56,h-119,18,i?'#9acbd3':'#d8b68b');}
     }
     cache.set(key,c);return c;
   };
   map.renderFurniture=function(ctx,room){previous(ctx,room);const c=staticArt(room);ctx.drawImage(c,room.bounds.x,room.bounds.y);
     const sim=window.Sim;if(!sim)return;
     const b=room.bounds, r=room.id;
     if(['power','lifeSupport','greenhouse','shelter','comms'].includes(r)){
       // Room status lights are connected to the same state used by every mission.
       const status=r==='power'?sim.batteryCharge>40:r==='lifeSupport'?sim.scrubberOperational&&sim.oxygenGeneratorOperational:r==='greenhouse'?sim.greenhouseCropHealth>35:r==='shelter'?sim.stormShelterShieldLocked:sim.antennaAligned;
       const x=b.x+b.w-47,y=b.y+58;
       ctx.save();const c=status?'#98e9b9':'#e1ad7b';ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.globalAlpha=0.22;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,13,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
     }
   };
   return true;
 }
 function install(){if(window.MoonshiftV25?.installed)return;
   window.MoonshiftV25={version:'25',installed:true,_currentCleanup:null,coverage:['moon station art','7 native mission visualizers','NASA source links','responsive tasks'],bootTime:Date.now()};
   installTasks();addStationArt();
   // Reinstate the enhancement after they have finished, without wrapping twice.
   setTimeout(installTasks,360);setTimeout(installTasks,1100);
 }
 if(document.readyState==='loading'){document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',install,{once:true});window.addEventListener('load',install,{once:true});}else install();
})();

</script>
<style id="v30-styles">
