.v23-range-label input[type=range]{accent-color:#83d4c2}
.v30-science-disclaimer,.v30-coach-note{font-size:11px;color:#aec0d3;line-height:1.5}
.v30-tool-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:12px}
.v30-coach{border:1px solid #83c7d3;border-radius:12px;background:#244c5e;color:#e4f8f8;padding:11px 14px;font-weight:750;cursor:pointer}
#v30-assistant-launch{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:20px;z-index:199999;border:1px solid #8bd6df;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#224c5e,#122b3b);color:white;border-radius:20px;padding:12px 18px;box-shadow:0 12px 34px #0008;font:700 14px system-ui;cursor:pointer}
#v30-assistant-panel{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:84px;width:min(355px,calc(100vw - 26px));max-height:min(580px,80vh);z-index:200000;background:#102533;border:1px solid #548799;border-radius:21px;color:#e5f6fb;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #000a;padding:17px;font:14px system-ui;display:none;overflow:auto}
#v30-assistant-panel.open{display:block}#v30-assistant-panel h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:19px}#v30-assistant-panel p{line-height:1.5;color:#b7cfda}
#v30-assistant-panel button{border:1px solid #709eac;background:#23485a;color:white;border-radius:11px;padding:10px;cursor:pointer}
#v30-assistant-panel .v30-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0}
#v30-assistant-panel textarea{width:100%;min-height:65px;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;background:#091a26;color:#eaf8fc;border:1px solid #4b7b90;resize:vertical;box-sizing:border-box}
#v30-assistant-log{max-height:120px;overflow:auto;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;border-top:1px solid #36586a;padding-top:9px}
@media(max-width:620px){#v30-assistant-launch{right:12px;bottom:12px}#v30-assistant-panel{right:10px;bottom:71px}}
</style>
<style id="v31-gameplay-style">
:root{--v31-ice:#b7eaf0;--v31-sky:#82c3d4;--v31-green:#9ee7cd;--v31-gold:#dfc496}
.v31-power-launch{position:fixed;left:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:19050;padding:12px 16px;min-height:48px;border:1px solid rgba(158,218,223,.55);border-radius:17px;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#174357,#102939);box-shadow:0 12px 35px #02091299;color:#e9fbfd;font:800 12px/1.35 system-ui;letter-spacing:.02em;cursor:pointer;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.v31-power-launch:hover,.v31-power-launch:focus-visible{background:#275f70;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.v31-power-launch strong{font:850 13px system-ui;color:#a5e8cd;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.v31-energy-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:220000;background:rgba(3,10,19,.76);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:clamp(9px,2vw,25px);box-sizing:border-box;color:#e8f7f9;font:14px/1.55 system-ui}
.v31-energy-dialog{width:min(1060px,100%);max-height:min(93dvh,980px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(149,198,218,.45);border-radius:24px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 0%,#1d4554 0%,transparent 44%),linear-gradient(160deg,#102c3c,#091a28 72%);box-shadow:0 25px 80px #000b}
.v31-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:21px clamp(17px,3vw,30px);border-bottom:1px solid #426c7b66}
.v31-overline{font:850 10px system-ui;letter-spacing:.17em;color:#9ed5e1;text-transform:uppercase}.v31-head h2{font:800 clamp(23px,3vw,31px)/1.14 system-ui;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:7px 0}.v31-head p{margin:0;color:#bad5de;font-size:12px}
.v31-close{border:1px solid #739aa888;background:rgba(31,69,84,.85);color:#fff;border-radius:12px;width:40px;height:40px;font-size:23px;cursor:pointer}
.v31-inside{overflow-y:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.08fr) minmax(300px,.92fr);gap:0;min-height:0}
.v31-visual{padding:clamp(16px,2.5vw,28px);background:#07192580;border-right:1px solid #496d7a55}
.v31-dashboard{border:1px solid #6a9dad58;border-radius:19px;padding:22px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#123a4c,#102537);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.v31-dashboard::after{content:'';position:absolute;right:-72px;top:-90px;width:280px;height:280px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(142,225,224,.09);box-shadow:0 0 0 35px rgba(119,192,206,.04),0 0 0 75px rgba(119,192,206,.025);pointer-events:none}
.v31-energy-bar{height:14px;border-radius:50px;background:#1d3d4b;border:1px solid #527787;overflow:hidden;margin:14px 0 5px}.v31-energy-bar>i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:50px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4991a3,#99e2c9);transition:width .22s ease}
.v31-number{font:850 clamp(29px,4vw,44px)/1.2 system-ui;color:#e8faff;letter-spacing:-.045em}.v31-number small{font-size:16px;color:#a7cbd4;letter-spacing:0}.v31-sub{color:#b5d0d9;font-size:12px}.v31-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:18px}.v31-metric{padding:14px 9px;background:#0a2332;border:1px solid #5d879450;border-radius:12px;min-width:0}.v31-metric small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#a3c4d0;margin-bottom:6px}.v31-metric b{display:block;font-size:18px;white-space:nowrap;color:#def9fb;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.v31-flow{margin-top:22px;padding:18px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #6b9b9c44;background:#0b2230;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:6px}.v31-flow div{text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#c0dce1}.v31-flow b{display:block;color:#a2e7db;font-size:22px;margin-bottom:7px}.v31-flow span{font-size:17px;color:#d7b98c}.v31-explanation{font-size:11px;line-height:1.65;color:#a7c2d0;margin-top:14px}.v31-details{padding:clamp(16px,2.5vw,26px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.v31-step{border:1px solid rgba(133,189,209,.27);border-radius:16px;background:rgba(18,47,63,.75);padding:17px}.v31-step h3{font:780 15px system-ui;margin:0 0 6px;color:#e9f5f8}.v31-step p{color:#aacbd6;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin:0 0 12px}.v31-step label{font-size:12px;color:#cfe4e9;display:block}.v31-step input{width:100%;accent-color:#8dd5cb;margin:13px 0 4px}.v31-step button{padding:11px 12px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #75b1bb;background:#234a5b;color:#e5f9fc;font:750 12px system-ui;cursor:pointer;max-width:100%;text-align:left}.v31-step button:disabled{opacity:.44;cursor:not-allowed}.v31-step button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#366b79}
.v31-confirm{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#a9ebed,#7fc9d9)!important;color:#0c2635!important;border-color:#d9fbfe!important;width:100%;text-align:center!important;padding:13px!important}
.v31-inline-repair{display:inline-block;margin:7px 5px 0;padding:7px 10px;color:#08232e!important;background:#9bdde0;border:0;border-radius:9px;font:850 11px system-ui;cursor:pointer}
.v31-energy-in-lab{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #81b7b8;background:#173f50;color:#e5f8f4;font:760 12px system-ui;cursor:pointer}
.v30-tool-row{padding:13px 14px;margin-top:13px;border:1px solid rgba(125,171,186,.25);border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(62,115,134,.13),rgba(13,40,56,.55));display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v30-coach{min-height:42px;border:1px solid rgba(145,210,218,.55);border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#244a5a,#174257);color:#e7faff;padding:11px 14px;font:800 12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 6px 22px #0003;cursor:pointer}
.v30-coach:hover{background:#366e79;box-shadow:0 6px 20px #0004}.v30-coach-note{font-size:11px;max-width:220px;line-height:1.4;color:#a4c9d7}
.v23-overlay .v23-lab{border-radius:22px!important;border-color:#608d9b!important;box-shadow:0 32px 96px #000a!important}.v23-header,.v23-footer{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#183b4b,#102839)!important}
.v23-overlay .v23-card{border-radius:15px!important;border:1px solid #648c9952!important;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#1a3a4c,#112636)!important}
.v23-overlay .v23-ctrl{border-radius:12px!important;min-height:44px;transition:background .15s ease,transform .15s ease}.v23-overlay .v23-ctrl:hover{background:#31596a!important;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.v31-live-readout{margin-top:8px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:11px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:#c6e9e6;background:rgba(60,131,116,.13);border:1px solid rgba(103,190,164,.35)}
.v31-guidance{margin-top:18px;padding:17px 19px;border:1px solid rgba(143,200,208,.24);background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(27,70,82,.35),rgba(9,29,42,.7));border-radius:16px;display:grid;gap:11px}.v31-guidance strong{font:850 11px system-ui;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#a5d5df}.v31-guidance span{font:650 12px system-ui;color:#c1dce4}.v31-guidance i{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:28px;height:25px;margin-right:10px;color:#c5f0de;background:#23505c;border:1px solid rgba(162,224,218,.3);border-radius:9px;font:850 10px system-ui;font-style:normal}
@media(max-width:760px){.v31-inside{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v31-visual{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #496d7a55}.v31-head{padding:15px 18px}.v31-power-launch{left:9px;bottom:8px;min-height:42px;padding:9px 11px;font-size:10px}.v31-metrics{gap:5px}.v31-metric{padding:11px 6px}.v31-metric b{font-size:15px}.v31-flow{gap:3px;padding:10px}.v31-dialog{border-radius:15px}.v31-details{gap:10px}.v31-energy-overlay{padding:7px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v31-energy-bar>i,.v31-power-launch,.v23-overlay .v23-ctrl{transition:none!important}}
</style>
<script id="v31-power-recovery">
(()=>{'use strict';if(window.MoonshiftEnergy)return;
let overlay=null,serviced=false,conserving=false,hours=2;
const sim=()=>window.Sim, clamp=(x,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));
function supply(){const s=sim();const after=s.solarCapacityMax*Math.max(s.sunIllumination,.84)*Math.max(s.solarEventMultiplier,.95);return {solar:+after.toFixed(1),demand:10+2+4+4+1};}
function current(){const s=sim(),loads=Object.values(s.powerAllocations).reduce((a,b)=>a+Number(b),0);return {solar:s.solarCapacityMax*s.sunIllumination*s.solarEventMultiplier,load:loads,net:s.solarCapacityMax*s.sunIllumination*s.solarEventMultiplier-loads,bat:s.batteryCharge,max:s.batteryCapacityMax};}
function preview(){const s=sim(),v=current();const possible=supply(),plannedSolar=serviced?possible.solar:v.solar,plannedLoad=conserving?possible.demand:v.load,delta=(plannedSolar-plannedLoad)*hours;return {plannedSolar,plannedLoad,delta,after:clamp(v.bat+delta,0,v.max),available:plannedSolar-plannedLoad};}
function format(v){return Number(v).toFixed(1)}
function refresh(){if(!overlay)return;const v=current(),p=preview();const q=id=>overlay.querySelector('#'+id);
q('v31-battery').textContent=format(v.bat);q('v31-capacity').textContent=format(v.max);q('v31-bar').style.width=clamp(v.bat/v.max*100,0,100)+'%';
q('v31-solar').textContent=format(v.solar)+' kW';q('v31-load').textContent=format(v.load)+' kW';q('v31-net').textContent=(v.net>=0?'+':'')+format(v.net)+' kW';
q('v31-after').textContent=format(p.after)+' / '+format(v.max)+' kWh';q('v31-projected').textContent=(p.delta>=0?'+':'')+format(p.delta)+' kWh in '+hours+'h';q('v31-planned').textContent=`Projected solar ${format(p.plannedSolar)} kW · demand ${format(p.plannedLoad)} kW · surplus ${format(p.available)} kW`;
q('v31-hours-value').textContent=hours+' h';q('v31-clean').textContent=serviced?'✓ Panels aligned and serviced':'01 · Align / clean the solar arrays';q('v31-save').textContent=conserving?'✓ Essential-only power routing selected':'02 · Prioritize essential loads';
q('v31-charge').disabled=p.available<=0||v.bat>=v.max-.01;
const status=q('v31-status');if(!serviced||!conserving){status.textContent='Complete the panel and power-routing steps, then choose a charging window.';status.style.color='#b9d6e1'}else if(p.available<=0){status.textContent='Insufficient sun. Adjust the supply and loads first. Sunlight cannot charge a battery during a deep outage.';status.style.color='#f6c6ac'}else{status.textContent='Ready to charge. Energy gained is limited by actual solar surplus in this training model.';status.style.color='#9be5c9'}
}
function ensureButton(){if(document.querySelector('#v31-power-button'))return;const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='v31-power-launch';b.id='v31-power-button';b.innerHTML='⚡ <span>POWER RECOVERY</span> <strong id="v31-power-percent">—</strong>';b.onclick=open;document.body.append(b);setInterval(()=>{let s=sim(),v=document.querySelector('#v31-power-percent');if(v&&s)v.textContent=Math.round(100*s.batteryCharge/Math.max(1,s.batteryCapacityMax))+'%';},950)}
function open(){if(overlay){refresh();return;}const s=sim();if(!s)return;serviced=false;conserving=false;hours=2;overlay=document.createElement('div');overlay.className='v31-energy-overlay';overlay.innerHTML=`<section class="v31-energy-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Solar power recovery" tabindex="-1"><header class="v31-head"><div><div class="v31-overline">MISSION SCIENCE · ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS</div><h2>Restore Station Power</h2><p>Service the solar system, protect essential equipment, then harvest a safe charging window.</p></div><button type="button" class="v31-close" id="v31-close" aria-label="Close energy recovery">×</button></header><div class="v31-inside"><div class="v31-visual"><div class="v31-dashboard"><div class="v31-overline">LIVE BATTERY RESERVE</div><div class="v31-number"><span id="v31-battery">0</span> <small>/ <span id="v31-capacity">250</span> kWh</small></div><div class="v31-energy-bar"><i id="v31-bar"></i></div><div class="v31-sub">Stored energy; not the same as power in kW</div><div class="v31-metrics"><div class="v31-metric"><small>☀️ Solar supply</small><b id="v31-solar">—</b></div><div class="v31-metric"><small>⚙️ Demand</small><b id="v31-load">—</b></div><div class="v31-metric"><small>↗ Net charging</small><b id="v31-net">—</b></div></div></div><div class="v31-flow"><div><b>☀️</b>Solar arrays</div><span>→</span><div><b>⚡</b>Life systems</div><span>→</span><div><b>🔋</b>Stored reserve</div></div><div class="v31-guidance" aria-label="How to recover"><strong>YOUR RECOVERY ROUTE</strong><span><i>01</i> Repair / align the array</span><span><i>02</i> Protect the essential circuits</span><span><i>03</i> Charge using the surplus power</span></div><p class="v31-explanation">Physics-based teaching model: solar power (kW) minus running equipment (kW) gives battery charging rate. Battery storage (kWh) grows only if solar production exceeds electrical demand. Solar alignment and task timing are simplified training assumptions, not real NASA hardware procedures.</p></div><div class="v31-details"><section class="v31-step"><h3>01 · Recover solar supply</h3><p>Clear dust and angle the panels toward an illuminated horizon. In this exercise this restores the modeled array efficiency and usable sunlight.</p><button type="button" id="v31-clean">01 · Align / clean the solar arrays</button></section><section class="v31-step"><h3>02 · Balance the power grid</h3><p>Temporarily postpone experiments and dim the greenhouse; preserve air, thermal control and at least <strong>4 kW</strong> for radio communications.</p><button type="button" id="v31-save">02 · Prioritize essential loads</button></section><section class="v31-step"><h3>03 · Harvest a charging window</h3><label for="v31-hours">Simulate <strong id="v31-hours-value">2 h</strong> in good sunlight. Charging is limited to available surplus.</label><input type="range" id="v31-hours" min="1" max="4" value="2" step="1"/><div class="v31-live-readout" id="v31-planned">—</div><div class="v31-live-readout"><strong id="v31-after">—</strong><br/><span id="v31-projected">—</span></div><p style="margin:9px 0" id="v31-status"></p><button type="button" class="v31-confirm" id="v31-charge">CHARGE BATTERY · COMPLETE MISSION</button></section></div></div></section>`;
document.body.append(overlay);overlay.querySelector('.v31-energy-dialog')?.focus();const q=id=>overlay.querySelector('#'+id);
q('v31-close').onclick=close;q('v31-clean').onclick=()=>{serviced=true;s.solarEventMultiplier=Math.max(s.solarEventMultiplier,.95);s.sunIllumination=Math.max(s.sunIllumination,.84);s.solarGeneration=s.solarCapacityMax*s.sunIllumination*s.solarEventMultiplier;s.netPower=s.solarGeneration-s.totalDemand;refresh()};
q('v31-save').onclick=()=>{conserving=true;Object.assign(s.powerAllocations,{lifeSupport:10,greenhouse:2,communications:4,thermalHeaters:4,auxiliary:1});s.update(0);refresh()};
q('v31-hours').oninput=e=>{hours=Number(e.target.value);refresh()};
q('v31-charge').onclick=()=>{const p=preview();if(p.available<=0||s.batteryCharge>=s.batteryCapacityMax)return;const gained=clamp(p.available*hours,0,s.batteryCapacityMax-s.batteryCharge);s.batteryCharge+=gained;s.missionFailed=false;document.querySelector('.v20-failure-overlay')?.remove();s.missionTimeHours+=hours;s.update(0);window.Save?.schedule?.();window.Save?.save?.();refresh();q('v31-status').textContent=`✓ Mission accomplished! The battery stored ${format(gained)} kWh over ${hours} simulated hours. Go back to your radio task.`;window.MissionUI?.notify?.(`🔋 Battery +${format(gained)} kWh. Radio has ${s.powerAllocations.communications} kW allocated.`);};
overlay.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===overlay)close()});refresh();}
function close(){overlay?.remove();overlay=null;}
window.MoonshiftEnergy={open,close,refresh,get available(){return true},preview,measurement:current};
function init(){ensureButton();}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});else init();
})();
</script>
<script>(() => {
  'use strict';
  if (window.__MOONSHIFT_V322__) return;
  window.__MOONSHIFT_V322__ = true;

  // FIX 02: Address the effective output gain, not just the range control.
  // The previous constructor converted a missing localStorage preference to Number(null)=0.
  function tuneAudio() {
    const mixer = window.MoonshiftAudioMixer;
    if (!mixer || mixer.__v322OutputTuned) return false;
    mixer.__v322OutputTuned = true;
    let stored = null;
    try { stored = localStorage.getItem('moonshift.v32.volume'); } catch (_) {}
    if (stored === null) mixer.userVolume = .42;
    mixer.applyLevel = function (duration = .42) {
      if (!this.output || !this.ctx) return;
      // Speech is clearly audible; music remains discernible while ducked.
      // Output is deliberately limited to 0.58 gain (well below unity).
      const gain = (this.enabled ? this.userVolume * (this.ducked ? .25 : 1) * .58 : 0);
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
      this.output.gain.cancelScheduledValues(now);
      this.output.gain.setTargetAtTime(Math.max(0, Math.min(.58, gain)), now, Math.max(.035, duration / 4));
    };
    mixer.refreshUI?.();
    mixer.applyLevel(.18);
    return true;
  }

  // FIX 04: power recovery and current goal form one compact, consistent HUD group.
  function placeObjective() {
    const power = document.getElementById('v31-power-button');
    const objective = document.querySelector('.hud-objective-bar');
    if (!power || !objective) return false;
    let stack = document.getElementById('v322-hud-stack');
    if (!stack) {
      stack = document.createElement('div');
      stack.id = 'v322-hud-stack';
      stack.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Current objective and station power recovery');
      document.body.appendChild(stack);
    }
    if (power.parentNode !== stack) stack.appendChild(power);
    if (objective.parentNode !== stack) stack.appendChild(objective);
    const span = objective.querySelector('#hudObjectiveText');
    if (span) span.setAttribute('title', span.textContent || 'Current mission objective');
    return true;
  }

  const update = () => { tuneAudio(); placeObjective(); };
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', update, {once:true});
  else update();
  const observer = new MutationObserver(() => update());
  observer.observe(document.body, {childList: true, subtree: false});
  window.MoonshiftV322 = {
    version: '32.2',
    get objectiveGrouped() {return !!document.getElementById('v322-hud-stack')?.contains(document.querySelector('.hud-objective-bar'));},
    get musicGain() {const a=window.MoonshiftAudioMixer;return a?{userVolume:a.userVolume,enabled:a.enabled,ducked:a.ducked,maximumGain:.58}:null;}
  };
})();

/* MOONSHIFT V32.3 — Lab layout coordination, voice modal visibility.
   Never interrupts an existing AI session; does not alter gameplay or audio. */
(()=>{'use strict';if(window.MoonshiftV323)return;
 let autoMini=false;let lastLab=null;
 const update=()=>{
   const lab=document.querySelector('.v23-overlay .v23-lab');
   if(lab){lab.closest('.v23-overlay')?.classList.add('v323-lab-active');}
   const root=document.getElementById('v32-voice-root');
   const modal=!!document.querySelector('.v23-overlay,.task-overlay,.nx-overlay,.v31-energy-overlay,.mission-guide-overlay');
   if(root){const callActive=!['closed','ended','error'].includes(root.dataset.phase||'closed');
     root.classList.toggle('v323-during-lab',!!lab);
     if(modal&&callActive&&!root.classList.contains('v32-minimized')){root.classList.add('v32-minimized');autoMini=true;}
     if(!modal&&autoMini){root.classList.remove('v32-minimized');autoMini=false;}
   }
   lastLab=lab;
 };
 let scheduled=false;const schedule=()=>{if(scheduled)return;scheduled=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{scheduled=false;update()})};
 const ready=()=>{update();new MutationObserver(schedule).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['data-phase']});};
 if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',ready,{once:true});else ready();
 window.MoonshiftV323={version:'32.3',update};
})();
</script><script>(()=>{'use strict';
if(window.MoonshiftEnvironment324)return;
const installed={version:'32.4',rooms:[],worlds:['moon','orbit','mars'],audioOrMissionsChanged:false};
window.MoonshiftEnvironment324=installed;
const artCache=new Map();
function paintRoomArt(room,world){
 const w=Math.max(1,Math.round(room.bounds.w)),h=Math.max(1,Math.round(room.bounds.h));
 const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;const g=c.getContext('2d');
 const mars=world==='mars',orbit=world==='orbit',amber=mars?'#dfab83':'#e5bd83',cyan=orbit?'#8ecbd9':'#86cddd',green='#9cd7ad';
 const fill=(x,y,ww,hh,color,r=0)=>{if(ww<=0||hh<=0)return;g.fillStyle=color;g.beginPath();g.roundRect(x,y,ww,hh,r);g.fill()};
 const line=(x,y,X,Y,color,width=2)=>{g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x,y);g.lineTo(X,Y);g.lineWidth=width;g.strokeStyle=color;g.stroke()};
 const ring=(x,y,r,color,width=2)=>{g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);g.lineWidth=width;g.strokeStyle=color;g.stroke()};
 const disk=(x,y,r,color)=>{g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);g.fillStyle=color;g.fill()};
 const label=(x,y,text,color='#c2d9de',size=11)=>{g.save();g.font=`700 ${size}px system-ui,sans-serif`;g.fillStyle=color;g.textBaseline='middle';g.fillText(text,x,y);g.restore()};
 const console=(x,y,ww,hh,color=cyan)=>{fill(x+3,y+6,ww,hh,'#081c28aa',9);fill(x,y,ww,hh,'#102b3c',8);g.lineWidth=2;g.strokeStyle='#658b98';g.strokeRect(x+4,y+4,ww-8,hh-8);fill(x+11,y+11,Math.max(8,ww-22),4,color,3);for(let k=0;k<3;k++)fill(x+12,y+29+k*10,Math.max(9,ww*(.36+k*.11)),2,'#80a9b05e',1)};
 const indicator=(x,y,on=true)=>{disk(x,y,5,on?'#98e4b9':'#d9ae87');ring(x,y,8,'#bedfd948',1)};
 const tank=(x,y,ww,hh,contents)=>{fill(x,y,ww,hh,'#193748',ww/2);g.strokeStyle='#719eab';g.lineWidth=2;g.strokeRect(x+1,y+9,ww-2,hh-18);fill(x+6,y+hh*.47,ww-12,hh*.43,contents,4);fill(x+ww*.18,y-7,ww*.64,7,'#75919d',3)};
 const pipe=(points,color=cyan,width=5)=>{g.beginPath();points.forEach((p,i)=>i?g.lineTo(p[0],p[1]):g.moveTo(p[0],p[1]));g.strokeStyle='#071b25';g.lineWidth=width+4;g.stroke();g.strokeStyle=color;g.lineWidth=width;g.stroke();};
 const hazard=(x,y,ww=100)=>{fill(x,y,ww,14,'#223b47',2);g.save();g.beginPath();g.rect(x,y,ww,14);g.clip();for(let k=-20;k<ww+20;k+=24){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x+k,y+14);g.lineTo(x+k+13,y);g.lineWidth=8;g.strokeStyle='#dfb476';g.stroke()}g.restore()};
 const hatch=(x,y,r)=>{disk(x,y,r,'#0a202e');ring(x,y,r,'#8eb9c6',5);ring(x,y,r-12,'#28495b',4);ring(x,y,r-22,'#80a5af77',2);for(let a=0;a<8;a++){const ang=a*Math.PI/4;disk(x+Math.cos(ang)*(r-8),y+Math.sin(ang)*(r-8),3,'#e2c28a')}};
 const bounds=(x,y,ww,hh)=>{fill(x,y,ww,hh,'#203a48',8);g.strokeStyle='#567b8b';g.lineWidth=2;g.strokeRect(x+2,y+2,ww-4,hh-4)};
 const plant=(x,y,s=1)=>{line(x,y,x,y-28*s,'#87cba0',4*s);g.fillStyle='#a2d8ae';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x-10*s,y-18*s,12*s,5*s,-.45,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x+9*s,y-26*s,11*s,5*s,.55,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill()};
 const topRail=()=>{fill(26,43,w-52,7,'#456a76',3);fill(34,45,w-68,2,'#9ac8cb6a',1)};
 const bottomRail=()=>{fill(25,h-31,w-50,6,'#395565',3);for(let x=42;x<w-40;x+=67)disk(x,h-28,2,'#95b8bf6e')};
 topRail();bottomRail();
 // Three quiet structural seams make unrelated modules feel built from a single kit.
 for(const x of [22,w-22]){line(x,88,x,h-45,'#92b5bf1c',2);for(let y=109;y<h-60;y+=115){fill(x-4,y,8,13,'#65899455',2)}}
 switch(room.id){
 case 'airlock':{
   // The old flat exterior block reads as unfinished. Replace it with a continuous, graded regolith transition.
   const grd=g.createLinearGradient(0,h*.49,0,h);grd.addColorStop(0,'#253543');grd.addColorStop(.52,orbit?'#253849':mars?'#674b47':'#485663');grd.addColorStop(1,orbit?'#283c4a':mars?'#72524a':'#566573');
   fill(24,h*.51,w-48,h*.44,grd,7);
   // Pressurised EVA chamber: door at the top, lockers and suit prep to the sides.
   hatch(150,149,50);
   label(106,210,'PRESSURE LOCK',amber,11);
   for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const x=i===0?39:229;bounds(x,117,48,106);fill(x+14,134,20,27,'#a9bdc5',10);fill(x+10,163,28,36,'#d4e2dc',8);fill(x+6,172,8,24,'#769eaa',4);fill(x+34,172,8,24,'#769eaa',4);fill(x+14,199,8,13,'#a5b9ba',2);fill(x+27,199,8,13,'#a5b9ba',2);label(x+7,228,'EVA '+(i+1),cyan,9)}
   const rx=w-155;console(rx,121,112,96,amber);label(rx+15,164,'O₂ READY',green,12);indicator(rx+93,177,true);
   pipe([[rx+14,211],[rx+14,234],[w-80,234],[w-80,254]],'#80b8c8',3);
   hazard(40,251,w-80); // Visible demarcation between sealed preparation and outside staging.
   console(44,h-160,141,80,cyan);label(57,h-123,'ROVER PREP',cyan,12);
   for(let j=0;j<3;j++){const tx=188+j*44;fill(tx,h-159,32,55,'#1c3745',7);fill(tx+6,h-143,20,7,amber,2);fill(tx+9,h-129,14,20,'#7b9ba6',2)}
   label(45,h-54,orbit?'EXTERIOR MAINTENANCE':mars?'MARS EVA CHECK':'LUNAR EVA CHECK',amber,11);
   // Distinctive faint regolith tracks, never a diagonal black placeholder line.
   for(let j=0;j<3;j++)line(218+j*14,h-100,w-178+j*14,h-75,'#c5cfd21c',3);
   break;
 }
 case 'dock':{
   hatch(w*.5,130,70);console(46,252,130,73,cyan);console(w-176,252,130,73,amber);label(59,301,'DOCK SEALS',cyan,11);label(w-159,301,'CARGO LINK',amber,11);
   for(let i=0;i<5;i++){fill(64+i*88,h-88,60,38,'#2e5060',8);fill(77+i*88,h-76,34,7,amber,2)}
   label(54,h-115,'ARRIVAL / PRESSURISATION',cyan,11);hazard(40,222,w-80);break;
 }
 case 'centralHab':{
   console(35,247,152,84,cyan);console(w-187,247,152,84,amber);
   label(52,289,'CREW STATUS',cyan,12);label(w-168,289,'NAVIGATION',amber,12);
   for(let i=0;i<3;i++){disk(65+i*34,348,8,'#6c93a2');ring(65+i*34,348,11,'#a0cfce66',2)}
   label(w-180,h-63,'MISSION SYSTEMS',cyan,11);break;
 }
 case 'power':{
   // Existing cell banks remain authoritative. Add routed wiring, safety zones

   pipe([[44,157],[44,179],[w-44,179],[w-44,157]],amber,3);
   for(const x of [45,w-73]){bounds(x,236,28,72);indicator(x+14,251,true);fill(x+9,266,10,30,'#8d9f95',3)}
   pipe([[55,h-124],[w-55,h-124]],amber,5);
   label(55,h-144,'SOLAR / BATTERY DISTRIBUTION',amber,11);
   hazard(44,h-88,w-88);break;
 }
 case 'lifeSupport':{
   // Fan blades and monitors already exist; compact tanks occupy wall edges.
   tank(40,290,44,117,'#75b4ce');tank(w-85,290,44,117,'#8bcfb6');
   label(39,425,'H₂O',cyan,10);label(w-88,425,'O₂',green,10);
   pipe([[75,152],[75,140],[w-75,140],[w-75,152]],cyan,3);
   pipe([[75,h-121],[75,h-97],[w-74,h-97],[w-74,h-121]],green,3);
   label(65,119,'AIR + WATER RECOVERY',green,12);break;
 }

   if(orbit){console(60,h-139,w-120,65,cyan);label(83,h-104,'CONTROLLED SCIENCE BAY',cyan,12)}

   for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const a=(i-3)*Math.PI/14;line(x,256,x+Math.cos(a)*87,256+Math.sin(a)*87,'#5593ac48',2)}
   console(55,h-130,188,62,cyan);console(w-243,h-130,188,62,amber);
   label(72,h-94,'RELAY CONTROL',cyan,11);label(w-225,h-94,'PACKET UPLINK',amber,11);break;
 }
 case 'quarters':{
   for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const x=45+i*(w-100)/3;bounds(x,165,Math.min(150,(w-132)/3),125);fill(x+12,187,Math.min(120,(w-162)/3),35,'#8cabb4',12);fill(x+13,230,Math.min(119,(w-162)/3),41,'#b5c8b9',9);label(x+16,283,'SLEEP '+(i+1),cyan,10)}
   console(w/2-105,h-132,210,64,amber);label(w/2-86,h-96,'CREW SCHEDULE',amber,11);break;
 }
 case 'shelter':{
   for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const x=32+i*(w-64)/5;fill(x,105,18,145,'#466174',5);fill(x+4,112,10,131,'#8c9eae50',3)}
   console(w/2-100,135,200,82,amber);label(w/2-82,176,'SHELTER STATUS',amber,12);
   for(let i=0;i<3;i++){bounds(55+i*(w-110)/3,h-138,Math.min(130,(w-130)/3),66);label(68+i*(w-110)/3,h-101,'CREW BAY '+(i+1),cyan,10)}break;

   original(ctx,room);

     if(R>w)ctx.drawImage(image,iw-8,0,8,ih,w,0,R-w,h);

     ctx.restore();
   };
 }

 installed.rooms=Object.keys(map.rooms);installed.map=map;

}

}
